pages.title: Obsidian
pages.text:
Heavy gear built to protect your base.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 2000
- **Sword damage:** 7
- **Armor (full set):** 19

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: In the [Alloy Forge](entry://alloy_forge/alloy_forge), 2 obsidian and 1 iron ingot make 1 Reinforced Obsidian.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Unyielding tools:** 2000 durability, but they mine slowly.
- **Dense armor:** 2 toughness per piece, but each piece makes you 3%% slower.
- **Blast Wall:** the obsidian shield blocks explosions from every side, not just the front.
- Obsidian gear survives explosions when dropped.

pages.title: Blastproof
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** Explosions within 8 blocks of you break no blocks, so creepers can't blow holes in your base while you're home. Explosions also deal 60%% less damage to you.
